_comment: N2 (docs/taxonomy/04_ONTOLOGIA_CANONICA.md). Curated by hand from `uv run python -m scripts.audit_ontology` family 'composites', plus 4 perspective-only labels the separator heuristic cannot see (parenthetical/prefix form). Keys are `analysis.names._normalize_name` output. Consumed by `analysis.composite_labels.expand_composite`, applied once at `db.repository.register_match` (the single point every entry path funnels `sequence` through). Three shapes: {action,to} -> action event then a second event for `to` (dropped when `to` is a bare 'top'|'bottom'|'neutral' -- the existing exit-orientation anchor inference already supplies that, splicing a literal node for it would just reinvent `start top`/`start bottom`/`start neutral`); {state,action} -> state event then action event; {state,perspective} -> ONE event, label UNCHANGED, `perspective` added as metadata (04 S2: perspective is metadata, never a second state name).
